# Third-party notices / 第三方许可

`NOTICES.txt` contains dependency copyright and license texts. `inventory.json`
records package versions, upstream locations and declared licenses. Dependencies
retain their own rights; the Live Voice noncommercial license does not replace them.

`NOTICES.txt` 汇总依赖版权与许可正文，`inventory.json` 记录版本、上游来源和声明许可。
第三方组件保留原有权利，不适用 Live Voice 自有代码的非商业限制。

- Windows includes this directory inside `resources/app.asar`; Electron also supplies
  its own `LICENSE` and `LICENSES.chromium.html` beside the executable.
- Android packages it in `assets/third-party/`.
- iOS copies it into the app bundle and adds acknowledgements generated by CocoaPods.
- The release also provides a standalone notices file for reading without extraction.

- Windows 在 `resources/app.asar` 内携带本目录，EXE 同目录另有 Electron/Chromium 许可。
- Android 在 `assets/third-party/` 中携带本目录。
- iOS 随应用打包，并补充 CocoaPods 为当前依赖生成的 acknowledgements。
- 发布页也提供独立许可说明文件，可直接阅读。

The inventory includes runtime dependencies and some transitive build tooling
distributed by React Native; inclusion does not imply every component is executed
by every platform. When changing dependencies, review their upstream licenses and
refresh the inventory and notices before distributing a new build. Original license
text is retained in its source language.

清单包含运行依赖及 React Native 带入的部分构建工具，并不表示所有平台都会运行每一项。
更新依赖后须重新核对上游许可、清单和正文，再分发新版；许可原文保留其原始语言。
